# hivelocity_device_tags (Data Source)

Lists every tag in use on the account, or the tags of one device when `device_id` is set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All tags in use on the account
data "hivelocity_device_tags" "all" {}

# Tags of one device
data "hivelocity_device_tags" "web" {
  device_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device_id` (Number) Limit the result to the tags of this device.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags.
